description: Join Congressional Candidate Nikki Gronli for a night out with friends for karaoke and fundraising to get her to the finish line! Here's the skinny: $20 to sing $40 to sing with Nikki $50 to get OUT of singing And if you're feeling wild, donate $100 and Nikki will serenade you!
title: Karaoke Fundraiser! | Nikki G for SD
